render_thread.meaning: Instrumented RenderThread wall-duration slices; not CPU running time.

cpu_sched.meaning: Scheduled running intervals; CPU availability alone does not prove submission bottleneck.

gpu_work.meaning: GPU work slices when actually collected; no vendor-private bandwidth inference.

frequency.meaning: Opt-in application-exported frequency track; unit must be MHz. No automatic private counter access.

temperature.meaning: Opt-in application-exported temperature track; unit must be C and sensor source documented.

surfaceflinger.meaning: Compositor thread slices; not actual presentation unless instrumentation names establish that.

swap_wait.meaning: Explicit app bracket around swap; blocking may reflect pacing, not GPU saturation.

shader_compile.meaning: App-instrumented compile/link wall duration; GPU compilation internals are not inferred.

frame.meaning: App-defined frame wall intervals, not display refresh or presented frames.

cpu_submit.meaning: Explicit submit bracket; includes waiting unless independently excluded.
